name: Sudotrail
description: A Sudoku solver that explains each move. Built with Go and WebAssembly.
detail: Follow logical placements and candidate eliminations with visual explanations. Practice across 2,000 puzzles, import a photo (beta), and keep your progress in your browser. The Go solver runs locally through WebAssembly.
imageAlt: Sudotrail project preview: solve Sudoku step by step

name: Kafka Solo
description: A single-node message broker in Go, with partitioned topics and consumer rebalancing.
detail: Partitioned topics, persistent binary logs, key-based message routing, and automatic consumer rebalancing. A Go client SDK connects producers and consumers over a length-prefixed JSON protocol. Designed as a single-node broker.

name: Face Recognition as a Service
description: A two-tier face recognition service with queued requests and persistent results.
detail: A web application using AWS infrastructure, a request queue, and S3 to persist recognition results.
imageAlt: Illustration of face detection with a recognition frame

name: Cryptochain Blockchain Application
description: A cryptocurrency app with a blockchain, wallets, and peer-to-peer transactions.
detail: An Express backend and React frontend for viewing blocks, creating transactions, and mining transaction pools. Redis publish-subscribe keeps peer nodes in sync.
